title: Send a command's output to a file
summary: dup2 in the child, then exec: the new program writes to the file.
hints: In the child: `fd = open(file, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644); dup2(fd, STDOUT_FILENO); close(fd);` and only then `execvp`.
The redirection survives `exec`, because descriptors stay open across it. The parent prints `saved` after `wait`.
